memberdef.name: canonicalizePHIOperands

briefdescription.para: Removing duplicate PHI operands to leave the PHI in a canonical and predictable form.

detaileddescription.para: FIXME: It's really frustrating that we have to do this, but SSA-form in MIR isn't what you might expect. We may have multiple entries in PHI nodes for a single predecessor. This makes CFG-updating extremely complex, so here we simplify all PHI nodes to a model even simpler than the IR's model: exactly one entry per predecessor, regardless of how many edges there are.

memberdef.name: INITIALIZE_PASS_BEGIN

briefdescription.para: Provide a pass which mitigates speculative execution attacks which operate by speculating incorrectly past some predicate (a type check, bounds check, or other condition) to reach a load with invalid inputs and leak the data accessed by that load using a side channel out of the speculative domain.

detaileddescription.para: For details on the attacks, see the first variant in both the Project Zero writeup and the Spectre paper: https://googleprojectzero.blogspot.com/2018/01/reading-privileged-memory-with-side.html https://spectreattack.com/spectre.pdf
